THIS IS THE ORDER OF HON. PRO TEM MICHAEL MAU IN RESPONSE TO PLAINTIFF'S SC-108 REQUEST TO CANCEL JUDGMENT OF 01/19/18: CASE #855709 INCLUDED CLAIM FOR $400 WALL DEMO AND CHAN HAD NO RIGHT TO APPEAL. CHAN THEN FILED NEW CASE #856787 TO RE-LITIGATE SAME CLAIMS, INCLUDING THE $400.00 WALL DEMO: ALL ARE RES JUDICATA. THE COURT RE-REVIEWED AGAIN BOTH CASES, AND BOTH CASES SPECIFICALLY ALLEGED THE $400.00 WALL DEMO CLAIM. AS RES JUDICATA, THE JUDGMENT IN THIS CASE IS REVERSED AND CANCELLED. THE REQUEST TO CANCEL THE JUDGMENT IS GRANTED.
